pyusd.solana-supply.definition: PYUSD circulating on Solana on the latest complete day (DefiLlama).

pyusd.reserves.definition: Reserve assets held for PYUSD per the Paxos monthly attestation examined by KPMG.
pyusd.reserves.note: The September 2026 attestation PDF could not be retrieved; update from the next report.

pyusd.solana-share.definition: Share of redeemable PYUSD issued on Solana, per the Paxos monthly attestation.
pyusd.solana-share.note: DefiLlama circulating supply gives 25.1% on 2026-11-03, a different measure (circulating, not redeemable).
